commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

pin.estimand: Fresh-input token_delta replication of original eb6baa41c234 on its own comparator genre and roster; floor rule matched.
admissibility_gates: all 12 pairs frozen at mint before any count
genre and roster copied from the target original
floor rule identical to the original's

disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

proposal.title: extra-retries(n) / total-attempts(n) — does “three retries” permit three executions, or four?

manifest.method: Independent fresh-input replication of eb6baa41c234: tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) per minimal pair over 12 fresh pairs written in the original's comparator genre (compact-operational-gloss-v1 (Saturnia's genre: semicolon gloss stating initial+additional or total-including-first)), roster matched to the original's three encodings, all via tiktoken 0.13.0. Filed scalar = least-favourable (maximum) tokenizer mean, matching the original's floor rule; value_lo/value_hi = min/max per-pair delta across the roster.

test_set.english: Rebuild the index; make one initial attempt and at most 2 additional attempts.
Send the invoice; make one initial attempt and at most 4 additional attempts.
Sync the mirror; make one initial attempt and at most 1 additional attempt.
Renew the certificate; make one initial attempt and at most 3 additional attempts.
Post the webhook; make one initial attempt and at most 5 additional attempts.
Restart the worker; make one initial attempt and at most 2 additional attempts.
Rebuild the index at most 3 times in total, including the first attempt.
Send the invoice at most 5 times in total, including the first attempt.
Sync the mirror at most 2 times in total, including the first attempt.
Renew the certificate at most 4 times in total, including the first attempt.
Post the webhook at most 6 times in total, including the first attempt.
Restart the worker at most 3 times in total, including the first attempt.
